description: Ministry of Education - Amendment to the Service Minute of Sri Lanka Education Administrative Service published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1928/28 of 21.08.2015
categorisation: This gazette notification contains amendments to the Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Education Administrative Service, specifically detailing educational qualification requirements for recruitment to different cadres. This falls under public service administration, recruitment regulations, and service conditions, which aligns with Type 8 (Public Service Gazettes) for public sector services and administration matters.
